title: Sajjad tere gham me
body:
Sajjad tere gham me
(Hai sajjad hai hai sajjad) x2
<<MINI>>
(Sajjad tere gham mein zanjeer ro rahi hai) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
(Aankhon mein khwaab chupp hai) x2 tabeer ro rahi hai
<<MINI>>
(Sajjad tere gham mein zanjeer ro rahi hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Kaante biche hue hai jalti hui zameen par) x2 Chaale tarap rahe hai takdeer ro rahi hai, Aankhon mein khwaab chupp hai tabeer roh rahi hai
<<MINI>>
(Sajjad tere gham mein zanjeer ro rahi hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Abbas-e-bawafaa ki jageer karbala hain) x2 Abid ke gham me sari jageer ro rahi hai, Aankhon mein khwaab chupp hai tabeer roh rahi hai
<<MINI>>
(Sajjad tere gham mein zanjeer ro rahi hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Abid na kaise rowe aye shaamion bataao) x2 Zakhmee hai kaan jiske hamsheer ro rahi hai, Aankhon mein khwaab chupp hai tabeer roh rahi hai
<<MINI>>
(Sajjad tere gham mein zanjeer ro rahi hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Sajjad ke badan ka sabh khoon jhal chuka hai) x2
Paaon mein joo padhi hai zanjeer ro rahi hai, Aankhon mein khwaab chupp hai tabeer roh rahi hai
<<MINI>>
(Sajjad tere gham mein zanjeer roo rahi hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Aankhon se khoon abid kaise baha raha hai) x2 Ho kar har ek bibi dalgeer ro rahi hai, Aankhon mein khwaab chupp hai tabeer roh rahi hai
<<MINI>>
(Sajjad tere gham mein zanjeer roo rahi hai) x2
